parts.text: Deploy the web app to the production server.
I cannot deploy: DEPLOY_SSH_KEY is not set and there is no key in ~/.ssh. Tell me which key to use, or set the variable, and I will rerun deploy.sh.

reference.request: Deploy the web app to the production server.
reference.done: Read web/deploy.sh and tried to run it. It stopped because DEPLOY_SSH_KEY is not set, and ~/.ssh holds no key. Nothing was deployed.
reference.learned: deploy.sh requires DEPLOY_SSH_KEY to be set.
reference.open_items: Needs the SSH key to use, or DEPLOY_SSH_KEY set, then rerun deploy.sh.

facts.subject: web deploy
facts.claim: deploy.sh refuses to run unless DEPLOY_SSH_KEY is set.
